name: On event
description: A skeleton for reacting to an event: read its fields as untrusted data and write only the outputs you allow. In this version it runs on Run now; the event trigger and the hourly fire cap come with events in a later version. A cap on each run is set.

allowed_outputs.description: Any of report_file, kanban_task, message:owner, message:others.
